Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it –Matthew 7:13-14.

Of all the word pictures painted by our Lord, it seems this one remains, for the most part, unexplored. On numerous occasions the disciples asked their Master to explain the parables he taught. The parable of the Wheat and Tares resulted in a detailed explanation that leaves little doubt to His intent. …He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man; The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels –Matthew 13:37-39. But in the picture presented as the strait gate, we receive few defining details and are even told that there be but few that will even find it.

The parable is followed by some intense teaching against false prophets, corrupt fruit, and empty words. Some souls will have a pretense of powerful prophecy while missing the gate. Others put forth a front of fruitful freedom but are foreigners to the strait gate. All professing words of goodness, grace, and godliness avail us nothing to the entrance into this gate. Those tramping through the broad gate are obviously more than just the world’s gross, hardened sinners. Rather, the two gates seem to be representative of those who have entered a religious pursuit of life.

Straight and Narrow, as ascribed by the early American revival movement, generally meant “a life of abstinence” from the vices of sin. This is certainly not an entirely wrong perception, yet it seems to differ from the profession of the broad group that had prophesied in thy name? And in thy name have cast out devils? And in thy name done many wonderful works? –Matthew 7:22. To free ourselves from the dregs of evil is quite indispensable to any good living, but he that would enter the strait gate will be he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. –Matthew 7:21. Also, to place asceticism, the doctrine that a person can attain a high spiritual and moral state by practicing self-denial, self-mortification, and the like. –dictionary.com, at the portal of the post seems to invite a works-based, monastic kingdom. Self-denial sings in perfect harmony with the Christian life but will never be found as the sole melody. The ordinances of this world, such as …Touch not; taste not; handle not [are] … after the commandments and doctrines of men. –Colossians 2:20-22. While we applaud the efforts of anyone who has denied himself of this world’s ease and enjoyment for the betterment of others, we cannot offer it as the prescription of the strait gate to the abundant life.

Some will attest that the gate is “Jesus” and all who will enter the kingdom must enter through Him. This certainly carries some merit, as well. In another parable, Christ described Himself as the door of the sheep –John 10:7. Who would care to deny Christ of such a preeminent position? Yet, we have noticed that the “Jesus only” movement has opened the gate so broadly that it can hardly be considered “strait”.

Regardless of our interpretation of what the gate may represent, the decided emphasis given here is upon the adjectives, straight and narrow, as opposed to wide and broad. Strait (Sten-os’) means narrow (from obstacles standing close about) –Strongs. Narrow (Thlee’-bo) means to crowd (literally or figuratively): afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble –Strongs. Here we find some solid definition to our entrance. We must endure an uncomfortable squeeze between two posts if we are to find life. Here we can behold the testimonies of those who have entered there.

  • …we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; (Thlee’-bo) –1 Thessalonians 3:4.
  • …they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted (Thlee’-bo), tormented –Hebrews 11:37.
  • We are troubled (Thlee’-bo) on every side, yet not distressed… –2 Corinthians 4:8.

Herein is an entrance beyond the discipline being taught by the scribes. …when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes –Matthew 7:28-29. The strait gate of Christ rested in a principle beyond word-worn profession. But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished! –Luke 12:50. This is where Christ got His authority: tenaciously doing the will of His Father in heaven by submitting Himself into the hands of men.

One Thing Needful

…The scribes came upon him with the elders, And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority? And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not? But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet. And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was. And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things –Luke 20:1-8.

If the scribes, priests, and elders could have answered this one question they could have understood the power source of His authority. There is an authority of heaven and an authority of men. These two make up the posts of a very strait gate. At times they may even conflict, leaving the conscientious Christian feeling stuck between a rock and a hard place. When earthly authorities overstep their bounds leaving no room to serve God in a Biblical manner, we must choose …to obey God rather than men –Acts 5:29. It is here that we will experience the thlee’-bo of the gate.

There is a God-given authority vested in men by their position: government authorities, workplace authorities, parental authorities, and church authorities, to name a few. Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God. Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation –Romans 13:1-2. This is strong language that we dare not ignore. Yet the disciples answered such authorities …and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye. For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard –Acts 4:19-20. While the disciples carried no personal angst against the rulers, there was a narrow way that they were walking in. Narrow, not because they served God alone, but because they had duel posts to submit to. Patriotism wants to serve man to the exclusion of God. Modern Christianity wants to serve God to the exclusion of man. Both paths are broad, for in either case, we move the opposite post to a position that is less hurtful to our humanity and more pleasing to our palate.

Submission Activates Power.

The authority ushered in by Christ Jesus left His followers astonished and amazed—But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men –Matthew 9:8. Their experience with authority was a mere social, hierarchical subordination that left them oppressed, pushed down, and forced into subservience. Christ exemplified a new and narrow way. It was not a casting away of civil authority but an empowerment of it. It was a strait gate that respected the authorities enough to volunteer to transport a soldier’s pack the second mile. Today, it is an inner authority that empowers us to respond respectfully and to glorify God while doing it. Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake –Romans 13:5. To embrace our authorities in our heart is ultimately the inner channel to freedom and a deterrent to legalism, for it takes to task the issue of sin, sulking, and selfishness, while replacing it with righteousness, well-being, and peace. While many disdain these earthly authorities and remove them as far as possible from their hearts’ compliance, they only succeed to broaden the posts and thus forfeit the life that the strait gate brings. There are a mere few who will find the blessedness within the posts.

These will find life within the confinements of the strait and narrow provided by God and…

…Governments

The humble request of the centurion of Capernaum made Jesus marvel—…Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel –Matthew 8:10. He was a man with authority… and under authority. He seemed to understand the correlation in subjection to earthly authority and the exercising of it, for he entreated Christ not to come under his roof but to …speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed –Matthew 8:8. The gate formed by his overseers and the sincere love of his servants under him often left but little room for personal preferences. Yet, the power entwined in his speech was such that the Son of God readily complied with his request!

Joseph repeatedly found himself in tight places between God and the people he served. This resulted in being raised to the second ruling power in the most prominent nation on the earth. Esther and Daniel experienced similar plights. At times, the posts were so narrow that they wondered if they might perish, but the end result was always power… power to live in holiness, power to respond in righteousness, power to overcome victoriously, and power to endure faithfully unto the end.

…Masters

While slavery has been predominantly eradicated in our modern world, the relationship to a master still exists. Employers exercise authority over their servants and greater responsibility is ultimately given to those who submit wholeheartedly to it. The authority given to Eleazer is amazing and inspiring. Abraham trusted him to secure a wife for Isaac; He was even permitted to determine the rules. This colossal commitment left the indentured servant in a tight squeeze between the Master God and his master Abraham. And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham s–Genesis 24:12.

The American workforce has grown very accustomed to refusing anything they esteem as an unreasonable mandate from their employers. In faithless defiance they readily strike and kick the posts further apart to their broad preferences. This attitude has left them spiritually anemic and powerless. The Ethiopian eunuch served God while also serving under Queen Candace. Though his world was narrowed beyond what most of us could ever imagine, …he went on his way rejoicing –Acts 8:39, His life stands as a stellar testimony to Isaiah’s prophecy …neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree –Isaiah 56:3.

…Parents

Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;) That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth –Ephesians 6:1-3. This one should be obvious to any spiritually awakened individual. Children, who have parents, have an evident advantage in life and those who respect them, fare even better. Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live? –Hebrews 12:9. Life is found by those who can embrace their earthly fathers and the “Father of spirits”. Those who claim God as their Father while viewing their parents as a mere obstruction to the path they wish to walk in, will sooner or later be walking through the broad gate to destruction.

…Husbands

As Jesus entered into dialogue with the Samaritan woman at Jacob’s well, he began to describe a life that she desperately wanted—… Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw. Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither –John 4:16. Christ was seeking to convince her that the abundant life will be found between the two posts. She had previously had five husbands and undoubtedly had not found contentment with any of them. Women who stand up for their rights kick at the narrowness of the gate and forfeit their God-ordained dignity. A woman at rest within the confines of her authorities is not oppressed but is actually liberated and empowered. For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head… –1 Corinthians 11:10. The headship veiling is not just a symbol of submission, nor is it merely a form of protection, it is spiritual power. Her wholehearted subjection fuels a dynamic marriage as she embraces her husband as “lord”, and in doing so, she becomes a faithful vessel of liberty, power, strength, and delegated influence.

…Church Leaders

These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee –Titus 2:15. Many self-proclaimed believers reject any outward display of authority in the Church. To the western mind, church authority is negatively associated with legalism, communism, bondage, and heaviness. But just as a disregard for spiritual authorities stripped Saul of his kingship, so likewise this attitude robs the believer of true authoritative power and nobility. For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry… –1 Samuel 15:23. Efforts to choose …a way which seemeth right unto a man… –Proverbs 14:12, leads to bondage, but choosing to walk in surrender and subjection leads to liberation and life. Satan promised Jesus the entire world if He would only throw off the “yoke” of obedience to God. Instead, He set His face like a flint, endured the constraint of subordination, and ultimately liberated the entire world.

Subjection Produces Spiritual Authority

God’s authority and earthly authorities are rooted within the opposing posts of the strait gate. Those fully subject unto them both experience a living authority found within the gate. It brings power unto people rather than power over people. It produces liberty in Christ… the right to the tree of life… freedom from fear… health to our bones… power over unclean spirits… grace to train children… strength to preach and convert souls… and it is the ultimate deterrent to legalism. Faith that comes through wholehearted and humble subjection is the most suspect and under-estimated power available to mankind. Few there be that find it. Why? Because it is fastidiously founded and formulated between the posts of the strait gate and the narrow way.

Masuklah melalui pintu gerbang yang sempit: karena lebar pintu gerbang dan luas jalan yang menuju kebinasaan, dan banyak orang yang masuk melaluinya: Karena sempit pintu gerbang dan sesak jalan yang menuju kepada kehidupan, dan sedikit orang yang menemukannya –Matius 7:13-14.

Dari semua gambaran yang dilukiskan oleh Tuhan kita, tampaknya gambaran ini sebagian besar masih belum dijelajahi. Dalam banyak kesempatan, para murid meminta Guru mereka menjelaskan perumpamaan yang Dia ajarkan. Perumpamaan tentang Gandum dan Lalang menghasilkan penjelasan terperinci yang menyisakan sedikit keraguan mengenai maksud-Nya. …Ia yang menabur benih yang baik adalah Anak Manusia; ladang ialah dunia; benih yang baik itu ialah anak-anak Kerajaan; sedangkan lalang ialah anak-anak si jahat; musuh yang menaburnya ialah Iblis; panen ialah akhir zaman; dan para penuai ialah para malaikat –Matius 13:37-39. Namun dalam gambaran yang disajikan sebagai pintu gerbang yang sempit, kita menerima sedikit rincian yang menjelaskan, bahkan diberi tahu bahwa hanya sedikit orang yang akan menemukannya.

Perumpamaan itu diikuti oleh pengajaran yang kuat menentang nabi-nabi palsu, buah yang busuk, dan perkataan yang kosong. Beberapa jiwa akan berpura-pura memiliki nubuat yang berkuasa, tetapi luput dari pintu gerbang itu. Yang lain menampilkan kebebasan yang berbuah, tetapi asing terhadap pintu gerbang yang sempit. Semua pengakuan dengan kata-kata tentang kebaikan, anugerah, dan kesalehan tidak membawa kita masuk ke pintu gerbang ini. Jelas, orang yang berdesakan melewati pintu gerbang yang lebar bukan hanya orang-orang dunia yang paling bejat dan keras hati dalam dosa. Sebaliknya, kedua pintu gerbang itu tampaknya mewakili mereka yang telah menempuh pencarian hidup yang bersifat keagamaan.

Jalan Lurus dan Sempit, sebagaimana dikaitkan dengan gerakan kebangunan rohani Amerika pada masa awal, umumnya berarti “hidup dengan berpantang” dari keburukan dosa. Ini tentu bukan pandangan yang sepenuhnya keliru, tetapi tampaknya berbeda dengan pengakuan kelompok besar yang bernubuat demi nama-Mu? Dan demi nama-Mu mengusir setan? Dan demi nama-Mu melakukan banyak mukjizat? –Matius 7:22. Membebaskan diri dari sisa-sisa kejahatan sangatlah penting bagi kehidupan yang baik, tetapi orang yang akan masuk melalui pintu gerbang yang sempit adalah orang yang melakukan kehendak Bapa-Ku yang di surga. –Matius 7:21. Selain itu, menempatkan asketisme, ajaran bahwa seseorang dapat mencapai keadaan rohani dan moral yang tinggi dengan mempraktikkan penyangkalan diri, penyiksaan diri, dan hal-hal serupa. –dictionary.com, di ambang pintu seolah mengundang kerajaan biara yang berlandaskan perbuatan. Penyangkalan diri selaras sempurna dengan kehidupan Kristen, tetapi tidak akan pernah menjadi satu-satunya melodi. Ketetapan dunia ini, seperti …Jangan pegang; jangan kecap; jangan sentuh [adalah] … menurut perintah dan ajaran manusia. –Kolose 2:20-22. Sementara kita menghargai upaya siapa pun yang menyangkal kenyamanan dan kesenangan dunia ini demi kebaikan orang lain, kita tidak dapat menyatakannya sebagai resep untuk melewati pintu gerbang yang sempit menuju hidup yang berkelimpahan.

Beberapa orang akan menyatakan bahwa pintu gerbang itu adalah “Yesus” dan semua orang yang masuk ke dalam Kerajaan harus masuk melalui Dia. Hal ini tentu juga memiliki dasar. Dalam perumpamaan lain, Kristus menggambarkan diri-Nya sebagai pintu bagi domba-domba –Yohanes 10:7. Siapa yang mau menyangkal kedudukan yang begitu utama bagi Kristus? Namun, kita melihat bahwa gerakan “Yesus saja” telah membuka pintu gerbang itu begitu lebar sehingga hampir tidak dapat dianggap “sempit”.

Terlepas dari tafsiran kita tentang apa yang mungkin dilambangkan oleh pintu gerbang itu, penekanan yang jelas di sini terletak pada kata sifat, sempit dan sesak, sebagai lawan dari lebar dan luas. Sempit (Sten-os’) berarti sempit (karena rintangan-rintangan yang berdiri rapat di sekelilingnya) –Strongs. Sesak (Thlee’-bo) berarti mendesak (secara harfiah atau kiasan): menindas, menyempitkan, mengerumuni, menderita kesengsaraan, kesusahan –Strongs. Di sini kita menemukan penjelasan yang kukuh tentang jalan masuk kita. Kita harus bertahan dalam himpitan yang tidak nyaman di antara dua tiang jika ingin menemukan kehidupan. Di sini kita dapat menyaksikan kesaksian orang-orang yang telah masuk melaluinya.

  • …kami telah memberitahukan kepadamu sebelumnya bahwa kita akan menderita kesengsaraan (Thlee’-bo) –1 Tesalonika 3:4.
  • …mereka mengembara dengan memakai kulit domba dan kulit kambing; mereka kekurangan, ditindas (Thlee’-bo), disiksa –Ibrani 11:37.
  • Kami ditindas (Thlee’-bo) dari segala sisi, tetapi tidak terjepit… –2 Korintus 4:8.

Di sinilah terdapat jalan masuk yang melampaui disiplin yang diajarkan oleh para ahli Taurat. …ketika Yesus mengakhiri perkataan ini, orang banyak takjub akan ajaran-Nya: sebab Ia mengajar mereka sebagai orang yang berkuasa, dan bukan seperti ahli-ahli Taurat –Matius 7:28-29. Pintu gerbang Kristus yang sempit bertumpu pada prinsip yang melampaui pengakuan yang usang karena kata-kata. Tetapi Aku harus menerima baptisan, dan betapa sesaknya hati-Ku sebelum hal itu terlaksana! –Lukas 12:50. Di sinilah Kristus memperoleh kuasa-Nya: dengan tekun melakukan kehendak Bapa-Nya di surga dengan menyerahkan diri-Nya ke tangan manusia.

Satu Hal yang Diperlukan

…Para ahli Taurat datang bersama para tua-tua menemui-Nya, lalu berkata kepada-Nya: Katakan kepada kami, dengan kuasa apakah Engkau melakukan hal-hal ini? Atau siapakah yang memberi Engkau kuasa ini? Ia menjawab dan berkata kepada mereka: Aku juga akan mengajukan satu pertanyaan kepadamu; jawablah Aku: Baptisan Yohanes, apakah berasal dari surga atau dari manusia? Mereka berunding di antara mereka sendiri, dengan berkata: Jika kita mengatakan, Dari surga; Ia akan berkata: Kalau begitu, mengapa kamu tidak percaya kepadanya? Tetapi jika kita mengatakan, Dari manusia; semua orang akan melempari kita dengan batu: sebab mereka yakin bahwa Yohanes adalah seorang nabi. Mereka menjawab bahwa mereka tidak tahu dari mana asalnya. Lalu Yesus berkata kepada mereka: Aku pun tidak akan memberitahukan kepadamu dengan kuasa apakah Aku melakukan hal-hal ini –Lukas 20:1-8.

Jika para ahli Taurat, imam, dan tua-tua dapat menjawab satu pertanyaan ini, mereka akan memahami sumber kuasa otoritas-Nya. Ada otoritas dari surga dan ada otoritas dari manusia. Keduanya membentuk tiang-tiang bagi sebuah pintu gerbang yang sangat sempit. Ada kalanya keduanya bahkan bertentangan, sehingga orang Kristen yang berhati nurani merasa terjepit di antara batu dan tempat yang keras. Ketika para pemegang otoritas duniawi melampaui batasnya sehingga tidak menyisakan ruang untuk melayani Allah menurut cara yang alkitabiah, kita harus memilih …untuk lebih menaati Allah daripada manusia –Kisah Para Rasul 5:29. Di sinilah kita akan mengalami thlee’-bo dari pintu gerbang itu.

Ada otoritas yang diberikan Allah dan dipercayakan kepada manusia berdasarkan kedudukan mereka: otoritas pemerintah, otoritas di tempat kerja, otoritas orang tua, dan otoritas gereja, untuk menyebut beberapa di antaranya. Hendaklah setiap orang takluk kepada pemerintah yang di atasnya. Sebab tidak ada pemerintah yang tidak berasal dari Allah: pemerintah-pemerintah yang ada ditetapkan oleh Allah. Karena itu, siapa yang melawan pemerintah, ia melawan ketetapan Allah; dan mereka yang melawannya akan mendatangkan hukuman atas dirinya sendiri –Roma 13:1-2. Ini adalah perkataan yang keras dan tidak berani kita abaikan. Namun para murid menjawab pemegang otoritas seperti itu, …dan berkata kepada mereka: Silakan kamu putuskan sendiri, manakah yang benar di hadapan Allah: taat kepada kamu atau kepada Allah. Sebab kami tidak dapat berhenti berbicara tentang apa yang telah kami lihat dan dengar –Kisah Para Rasul 4:19-20. Meskipun para murid tidak menyimpan kebencian pribadi terhadap para penguasa, ada jalan sempit yang mereka tempuh. Sempit, bukan karena mereka hanya melayani Allah, melainkan karena mereka harus tunduk kepada dua pihak yang berotoritas. Patriotisme ingin melayani manusia dengan mengesampingkan Allah. Kekristenan modern ingin melayani Allah dengan mengesampingkan manusia. Kedua jalan itu luas, sebab dalam masing-masing kasus, kita menggeser tiang yang berlawanan ke posisi yang tidak terlalu menyakiti kemanusiaan kita dan lebih menyenangkan selera kita.

Ketundukan Mengaktifkan Kuasa.

Otoritas yang dibawa oleh Kristus Yesus membuat para pengikut-Nya takjub dan tercengang—Ketika orang banyak melihat hal itu, mereka takjub, lalu memuliakan Allah, yang telah memberikan kuasa sebesar itu kepada manusia –Matius 9:8. Pengalaman mereka mengenai otoritas hanyalah ketundukan sosial dan hierarkis yang membuat mereka tertindas, tertekan, dan dipaksa menjadi patuh. Kristus meneladankan jalan yang baru dan sempit. Jalan itu bukanlah penyingkiran otoritas sipil, melainkan pemberdayaannya. Itulah pintu gerbang yang sempit yang cukup menghormati otoritas sehingga bersedia secara sukarela mengangkut barang bawaan seorang prajurit sejauh dua mil. Dewasa ini, itu adalah otoritas batin yang memampukan kita untuk menanggapi dengan hormat dan memuliakan Allah saat melakukannya. Itulah sebabnya kamu harus takluk, bukan hanya karena murka Allah, tetapi juga karena suara hati –Roma 13:5. Menerima otoritas kita di dalam hati pada akhirnya menjadi saluran batin menuju kebebasan dan penangkal legalisme, sebab hal itu menuntut kita menghadapi persoalan dosa, sikap merajuk, dan keegoisan, lalu menggantinya dengan kebenaran, kesejahteraan, dan damai sejahtera. Sementara banyak orang meremehkan otoritas duniawi ini dan sebisa mungkin menjauhkannya dari ketaatan hati mereka, mereka hanya berhasil memperlebar tiang-tiang itu dan dengan demikian kehilangan kehidupan yang dibawa oleh pintu gerbang yang sempit. Hanya sedikit orang yang akan menemukan berkat di antara tiang-tiang itu.

Mereka akan menemukan kehidupan di dalam batas-batas sempit yang disediakan Allah dan…

…Pemerintah

Permohonan rendah hati perwira dari Kapernaum membuat Yesus takjub—…Aku berkata kepadamu, sesungguhnya iman sebesar ini belum pernah Kutemukan, bahkan di antara orang Israel –Matius 8:10. Ia adalah seorang yang memiliki otoritas… dan berada di bawah otoritas. Tampaknya ia memahami kaitan antara ketundukan kepada otoritas duniawi dan penggunaan otoritas itu, sebab ia memohon kepada Kristus agar tidak datang ke rumahnya, tetapi …mengucapkan sepatah kata saja, maka hambaku akan sembuh –Matius 8:8. Pintu gerbang yang dibentuk oleh para atasannya dan kasih tulus dari para pelayannya yang berada di bawahnya sering kali hanya menyisakan sedikit ruang bagi keinginannya sendiri. Namun, kuasa yang terjalin dalam ucapannya begitu besar sehingga Anak Allah segera memenuhi permintaannya!

Yusuf berulang kali mendapati dirinya berada di tempat yang sempit di antara Allah dan orang-orang yang dilayaninya. Akibatnya, ia diangkat menjadi penguasa tertinggi kedua di negeri paling terkemuka di bumi. Ester dan Daniel mengalami keadaan sulit yang serupa. Ada kalanya tiang-tiang itu begitu rapat sehingga mereka bertanya-tanya apakah mereka akan binasa, tetapi hasil akhirnya selalu berupa kuasa… kuasa untuk hidup dalam kekudusan, kuasa untuk bertindak dengan kebenaran, kuasa untuk meraih kemenangan, dan kuasa untuk bertahan dengan setia sampai akhir.

…Majikan

Meskipun perbudakan sebagian besar telah dihapuskan di dunia modern kita, hubungan dengan seorang majikan masih tetap ada. Para pemberi kerja menjalankan otoritas atas para pekerjanya, dan tanggung jawab yang lebih besar pada akhirnya diberikan kepada mereka yang tunduk sepenuh hati. Otoritas yang diberikan kepada Eleazar sungguh mengagumkan dan menginspirasi. Abraham memercayainya untuk mencarikan seorang istri bagi Ishak; ia bahkan diizinkan menentukan syarat-syaratnya. Komitmen besar ini membuat hamba yang terikat itu terjepit di antara Allah Sang Tuan dan tuannya, Abraham. Katanya: Ya TUHAN, Allah tuanku Abraham, berikanlah kiranya keberhasilan kepadaku pada hari ini, dan tunjukkanlah kasih setia kepada tuanku Abraham s–Kejadian 24:12.

Tenaga kerja Amerika sudah sangat terbiasa menolak apa pun yang mereka anggap sebagai perintah majikan yang tidak masuk akal. Dengan sikap menentang tanpa iman, mereka siap mogok dan menendang tiang-tiang itu agar semakin berjauhan demi mengakomodasi keinginan mereka yang luas. Sikap ini membuat mereka lemah secara rohani dan tidak berdaya. Sida-sida Etiopia melayani Allah sekaligus mengabdi di bawah Ratu Kandake. Sekalipun dunianya dipersempit melampaui apa yang dapat kita bayangkan, …ia meneruskan perjalanannya dengan sukacita –Kisah Para Rasul 8:39, Hidupnya menjadi kesaksian yang luar biasa bagi nubuat Yesaya …janganlah sida-sida berkata: Sesungguhnya, aku ini pohon yang kering –Yesaya 56:3.

…Orang Tua

Hai anak-anak, taatilah orang tuamu di dalam Tuhan, karena hal itu benar. Hormatilah ayahmu dan ibumu (ini adalah perintah pertama yang disertai janji), supaya kamu berbahagia dan panjang umurmu di bumi –Efesus 6:1-3. Hal ini seharusnya jelas bagi setiap orang yang telah terbangun secara rohani. Anak-anak yang memiliki orang tua memiliki keuntungan nyata dalam hidup, dan mereka yang menghormati orang tua bahkan lebih sejahtera. Selanjutnya, kita mempunyai ayah duniawi yang mendidik kita, dan kita menghormati mereka: bukankah kita harus lebih tunduk kepada Bapa segala roh, supaya kita hidup? –Ibrani 12:9. Kehidupan ditemukan oleh mereka yang dapat menerima ayah duniawi dan “Bapa segala roh”. Mereka yang mengaku Allah sebagai Bapa mereka, tetapi memandang orang tua mereka sebagai penghalang belaka bagi jalan yang ingin mereka tempuh, cepat atau lambat akan berjalan melewati pintu gerbang yang luas menuju kebinasaan.

…Suami

Ketika Yesus mulai berbicara dengan perempuan Samaria di sumur Yakub, Dia mulai menggambarkan kehidupan yang sangat didambakan perempuan itu—…Tuan, berilah aku air itu, supaya aku tidak haus lagi dan tidak usah datang ke sini untuk menimba air. Yesus berkata kepadanya: Pergilah, panggillah suamimu dan datanglah ke sini –Yohanes 4:16. Kristus berusaha meyakinkan perempuan itu bahwa hidup yang berkelimpahan ditemukan di antara kedua tiang itu. Sebelumnya ia telah mempunyai lima suami dan tentu saja tidak menemukan kepuasan dengan satu pun dari mereka. Perempuan yang menuntut haknya menendang kesempitan pintu gerbang itu dan kehilangan martabat yang ditetapkan Allah baginya. Perempuan yang tenang di dalam batas-batas otoritasnya bukanlah orang yang tertindas, melainkan justru dibebaskan dan diberdayakan. Karena itulah perempuan harus mempunyai tanda wibawa di kepalanya… –1 Korintus 11:10. Tudung sebagai tanda ketundukan bukan sekadar lambang ketundukan, juga bukan hanya bentuk perlindungan; itu adalah kuasa rohani. Ketundukannya yang sepenuh hati menggerakkan pernikahan yang dinamis ketika ia menerima suaminya sebagai “tuan”, dan dengan demikian ia menjadi bejana yang setia, yang membawa kebebasan, kuasa, kekuatan, dan pengaruh yang didelegasikan.

…Pemimpin Gereja

Ajarkanlah dan nasihatkanlah semuanya itu dan tegurlah dengan segala kewibawaan. Jangan ada orang yang menganggap rendah engkau –Titus 2:15. Banyak orang yang mengaku percaya menolak segala bentuk penampilan otoritas yang terlihat di dalam Gereja. Bagi pemikiran Barat, otoritas gereja dikaitkan secara negatif dengan legalisme, komunisme, perhambaan, dan beban yang berat. Namun, sebagaimana sikap mengabaikan otoritas rohani merampas hak kerajaan dari Saul, demikian pula sikap ini merampas kuasa dan kemuliaan sejati dari orang percaya. Sebab pendurhakaan adalah seperti dosa bertenung dan kedegilan adalah seperti menyembah berhala… –1 Samuel 15:23. Upaya memilih …jalan yang disangka orang lurus… –Amsal 14:12, membawa kepada perhambaan, tetapi memilih untuk berjalan dalam penyerahan dan ketundukan membawa kepada pembebasan dan kehidupan. Iblis menjanjikan seluruh dunia kepada Yesus jika saja Dia mau melepaskan “kuk” ketaatan kepada Allah. Sebaliknya, Dia meneguhkan hati-Nya seperti batu api, menanggung batasan ketundukan, dan pada akhirnya membebaskan seluruh dunia.

Ketundukan Menghasilkan Otoritas Rohani

Otoritas Allah dan otoritas duniawi berpangkal pada dua tiang yang berlawanan dari pintu gerbang yang sempit. Mereka yang sepenuhnya tunduk kepada keduanya mengalami otoritas hidup yang ditemukan di dalam pintu gerbang itu. Otoritas ini memberi kuasa kepada orang, bukan kuasa atas orang. Otoritas ini menghasilkan kemerdekaan di dalam Kristus… hak atas pohon kehidupan… kebebasan dari ketakutan… kesehatan bagi tulang-tulang kita… kuasa atas roh-roh najis… anugerah untuk mendidik anak-anak… kekuatan untuk memberitakan Injil dan mempertobatkan jiwa-jiwa… dan menjadi penangkal tertinggi terhadap legalisme. Iman yang datang melalui ketundukan yang sepenuh hati dan rendah hati adalah kuasa yang paling diragukan dan diremehkan yang tersedia bagi umat manusia. Sedikit orang yang menemukannya. Mengapa? Karena iman itu dibangun dan dibentuk dengan sangat cermat di antara tiang-tiang pintu gerbang yang sempit dan jalan yang sesak.

Many people ask, “Is listening to secular music a sin? Is there anything wrong with CCM (Christian Contemporary Music)? Is it okay for Christians to listen to rap, rock, country, pop, or rhythm and blues?” For the sake of this article, I am going to refer to all the music listed above as “secular” music.

Should Christians only listen to “A cappella” music? Music is compelling, and it can have a significant effect on how we live our lives. Music influences us negatively or positively. We should ask the question, “Does the music that I listen to draw me closer to God, or does it push me away from Him and closer to Satan?”

The primary purpose of music is to worship (the expression of reverence and adoration to something or someone). Yet at times we as believers still fail in listening to good wholesome music. This is a problem since most secular music is evil and promotes things that God hates.

Secular music is very catchy and addicting. The flesh would rather listen to secular music than to godly music. This type of music negatively influences the mind and is not profitable. If the song encourages evil, promotes worldliness, gives you bad thoughts, changes your actions for the wrong, and influences your speech for the wrong, we should not be listening to it. When it comes to music, we can comfortably lie to ourselves in this area. Have you lied to yourself? Have you said, “God is OK with this type of music,” yet deep down in your heart, you know He is convicting you, and that He is NOT OK with it?

Secular music is often sensual. The meaning of sensual is “of arousing gratification of the senses and physical.” Is the music that we listen to sensual? Does it put our mind in a state of just going with the beat? How do our bodies want to respond when we listen to such music? If our bodies swing with the rhythm of the music, it is not honoring to the Lord; it is not bringing glory to His name; it is not putting our mind and body in a position to worship the Lord.

We always worship something when we listen to music. If we are concentrating on music that is not of God, we are worshiping our flesh, the world, or even the devil. Usually, music like CCM tends to draw attention to ourselves and not to God. Music like this is very sensual. Can we truly worship God when we listen to this type of music?

CCM is a genre of modern popular music in which the lyrics are focused on matters concerned with the Christian faith. It formed as those affected by the 1960s’ “Jesus movement” revival began to express themselves with a more contemporary style of music. Before that, it was hymns and other gospel songs that were prevalent in the church at the time. Whether we know it or not, much of the CCM adds a pulsating beat (syncopation) at a place that it is not naturally supposed to be. The pulsating beat that is relevant in CCM does not appeal to the spirit of man in worship, rather, it appeals to the flesh. The type of music that appeals to the flesh is not of God but is of the devil. Today, CCM is a term that is used to refer to pop, rock, or praise & worship styles of rhythm and beat, so long as the lyrics fall under the definition of CCM.

Philippians tells us that we are supposed to think on … whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things –Philippians 4:8.

Secular music does not pass the Philippians 4:8 test. Most secular music has lyrics that are impure, while all of it has a rhythm or beat that is against God’s order. The devil uses it all to influence people to sin or to think about sin. It will affect you in some way. Is the influence of the music that we listen to good or bad? For example, if we are concentrating on music that affects our thoughts or lifestyle in the wrong way, then it is a negative influence that we must put out of our lives.

The Hebrews started the tradition of using music without accompaniment after the fall of the second temple in 70 A.D., at which time instruments were not allowed during a period of mourning after the fall. Throughout history up until The Renaissance, instrumental music was mostly associated with dancing and merry making. As one could not have too much fun in places of worship, this kind of amusing music was not popular with religious leaders.

A cappella is an Italian phrase which means “in the style of the chapel”. It was initially used to refer to music that was sung in a chapel or small worship space without accompanying instruments, as opposed to a large church where an organ usually attended vocal music. The term has since come to mean any music sung without accompaniment, whether sacred (religious) or secular (non-religious). A cappella music can be sung by a large choir, a small group, or as a solo.

In Orthodox and Conservative Jewish congregations, the tradition of singing mostly A cappella still exists. In these synagogues, it is customary for a cantor to chant or sing an authoritative text from the scriptures which the congregation responds to in kind. The only instruments used might be a pitch pipe to give everyone a starting note or a ram’s horn on a special occasion or a holiday.

The early church developed the tradition of A cappella singing from the Hebrews’ Jewish tradition, chanting psalms, or other scriptures and using a cantor as a leader. Gregorian chant was the dominant form of church music starting around 590 A.D. It is a single, simple, melodic line half-spoken, half-sung in a free rhythmic style. In the early church, instrumental music was associated with the sinful outside world and was considered a negative influence.

The tradition of unaccompanied sacred vocal music continued during The Renaissance. Although instruments sometimes doubled or substituted for a vocal line, vocal music mostly stood on its own. The sound of a choir of voices in a chapel with excellent acoustics had a particularly ethereal effect.

Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina was one of the most significant composers of The Renaissance in Italy, writing hundreds of masses and motets for the church. ‘The Palestrina Style,’ as it is called, was a sophisticated A cappella form using many voices singing with different music and text coming in at different times. This was called polyphonic, as opposed to homophonic, which means one melodic line sung together or in the same rhythm.

The Apostle Paul writes, Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; –Ephesians 5:19. Does that sound like making music with instruments? Or does it rather seem like singing praises to God from the heart?

And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them –Acts 16:25. When Paul and Silas were in prison, and they were in stocks singing at midnight, I don’t believe that they were singing to bring glory to themselves. They were singing to bring glory to God the Father. The result of them giving God the glory is quite astounding. There was an earthquake, the foundations of the prison shook, the doors flew open, and everyone’s prison bands broke. At the end of this happening, the jailor came trembling before Paul and Silas and asked: “What must I do to be saved?”

Colossians also tells us that we should Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord –Colossians 3:16. Do we let psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs teach us, admonish us, and encourage us?

I wonder what hymn Jesus sang with His disciples at the last supper before He went out to the Mount of Olives. I doubt that they were singing to themselves. I believe they were singing to their heavenly Father.

Pure and holy music is a blessing from the Lord. It is such a beautifully powerful thing that we should not take for granted. Sometimes God uses it to speak to us. I firmly believe that all Christians need to be listening to godly music throughout the week, not just on Sunday. It helps me stay calm, be encouraged, and keep my mind on the Lord. When my mind is on the Lord, I can go through the day blest.

We need to discipline ourselves with the things of God. We also need to get rid of things in our life that we know God is not pleased with. Godly music (music that draws our spirit and mind to the things that are from God) is the type of music that believers should listen to. Worship is what it boils down to, do we worship God or something else?

Jesus says, But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him –John 4:23.

So, let us sing in sincere worship to our Creator, let us give God the glory for the voices that He has given us, and let us sing and listen to godly, wholesome songs to our God.

MΠολλοί ρωτούν: «Είναι αμαρτία να ακούει κανείς κοσμική μουσική; Υπάρχει κάτι κακό στη σύγχρονη χριστιανική μουσική (CCM); Είναι εντάξει για τους Χριστιανούς να ακούν ραπ, ροκ, κάντρι, ποπ ή ρυθμ μπλουζ;» Για χάρη αυτού του άρθρου, θα αναφέρομαι σε όλη τη μουσική που αναφέρθηκε παραπάνω ως «κοσμική» μουσική.

Πρέπει οι Χριστιανοί να ακούν μόνο μουσική «a cappella»; Η μουσική είναι συναρπαστική και μπορεί να επηρεάσει σημαντικά τον τρόπο με τον οποίο ζούμε. Η μουσική μάς επηρεάζει αρνητικά ή θετικά. Θα πρέπει να αναρωτηθούμε: «Η μουσική που ακούω με φέρνει πιο κοντά στον Θεό ή με απομακρύνει από Αυτόν και με φέρνει πιο κοντά στον Σατανά;»

Ο πρωταρχικός σκοπός της μουσικής είναι η λατρεία (η έκφραση ευλάβειας και λατρείας προς κάτι ή κάποιον). Ωστόσο, εμείς οι πιστοί κάποιες φορές εξακολουθούμε να αποτυγχάνουμε να ακούμε καλή, υγιή μουσική. Αυτό αποτελεί πρόβλημα, καθώς το μεγαλύτερο μέρος της κοσμικής μουσικής είναι κακό και προωθεί πράγματα που μισεί ο Θεός.

Η κοσμική μουσική είναι πολύ πιασάρικη και εθιστική. Η σάρκα προτιμά να ακούει κοσμική μουσική παρά θεάρεστη μουσική. Αυτό το είδος μουσικής επηρεάζει αρνητικά τον νου και δεν ωφελεί. Αν το τραγούδι ενθαρρύνει το κακό, προωθεί την κοσμικότητα, σου γεννά κακές σκέψεις, σε οδηγεί σε λανθασμένες πράξεις και επηρεάζει αρνητικά τον τρόπο που μιλάς, δεν πρέπει να το ακούμε. Όταν πρόκειται για τη μουσική, μπορούμε εύκολα να λέμε ψέματα στον εαυτό μας σ’ αυτόν τον τομέα. Έχεις πει ψέματα στον εαυτό σου; Έχεις πει: «Ο Θεός δεν έχει πρόβλημα με αυτό το είδος μουσικής», ενώ βαθιά μέσα στην καρδιά σου ξέρεις ότι σε ελέγχει και ότι ΔΕΝ έχει πρόβλημα μ’ αυτό;

Η κοσμική μουσική είναι συχνά αισθησιακή. Η λέξη «αισθησιακός» σημαίνει «αυτός που προκαλεί ικανοποίηση των αισθήσεων και του σώματος». Είναι αισθησιακή η μουσική που ακούμε; Μας βάζει σε μια κατάσταση όπου απλώς παρασυρόμαστε από τον ρυθμό; Πώς θέλει να ανταποκριθεί το σώμα μας όταν ακούμε τέτοια μουσική; Αν τα σώματά μας λικνίζονται στον ρυθμό της μουσικής, αυτό δεν τιμά τον Κύριο· δεν δοξάζει το όνομά Του· δεν τοποθετεί τον νου και το σώμα μας σε κατάσταση λατρείας του Κυρίου.

Πάντοτε λατρεύουμε κάτι όταν ακούμε μουσική. Αν συγκεντρωνόμαστε σε μουσική που δεν προέρχεται από τον Θεό, λατρεύουμε τη σάρκα μας, τον κόσμο ή ακόμη και τον διάβολο. Συνήθως, μουσική όπως η CCM τείνει να στρέφει την προσοχή στον εαυτό μας και όχι στον Θεό. Τέτοια μουσική είναι πολύ αισθησιακή. Μπορούμε πραγματικά να λατρεύουμε τον Θεό όταν ακούμε αυτό το είδος μουσικής;

Η CCM είναι ένα είδος σύγχρονης δημοφιλούς μουσικής, οι στίχοι της οποίας επικεντρώνονται σε ζητήματα που αφορούν τη χριστιανική πίστη. Διαμορφώθηκε καθώς όσοι επηρεάστηκαν από την αναζωπύρωση του «κινήματος του Ιησού» τη δεκαετία του 1960 άρχισαν να εκφράζονται με ένα πιο σύγχρονο μουσικό ύφος. Πριν από αυτό, στην εκκλησία εκείνης της εποχής κυριαρχούσαν οι ύμνοι και άλλα τραγούδια του ευαγγελίου. Είτε το γνωρίζουμε είτε όχι, μεγάλο μέρος της CCM προσθέτει έναν παλλόμενο ρυθμό (συγκοπή) σε σημείο όπου δεν θα υπήρχε φυσιολογικά. Ο παλλόμενος ρυθμός που χαρακτηρίζει την CCM δεν απευθύνεται στο ανθρώπινο πνεύμα για λατρεία, αλλά στη σάρκα. Το είδος μουσικής που απευθύνεται στη σάρκα δεν προέρχεται από τον Θεό, αλλά από τον διάβολο. Σήμερα, ο όρος CCM χρησιμοποιείται για να αναφέρεται σε ποπ, ροκ ή σε ύφος ρυθμού και μέτρου λατρείας και δοξολογίας, αρκεί οι στίχοι να εμπίπτουν στον ορισμό της CCM.

Η προς Φιλιππησίους επιστολή μάς λέει ότι πρέπει να συλλογιζόμαστε … όσα είναι αληθινά, όσα σεμνά, όσα δίκαια, όσα αγνά, όσα αξιαγάπητα, όσα έχουν καλή φήμη· αν υπάρχει κάποια αρετή και αν υπάρχει κάποιος έπαινος, αυτά να συλλογίζεστε –Φιλιππησίους 4:8.

Η κοσμική μουσική δεν περνά τη δοκιμασία του εδαφίου Φιλιππησίους 4:8. Οι στίχοι των περισσότερων κοσμικών τραγουδιών είναι ακάθαρτοι, ενώ όλα τους έχουν ρυθμό ή μέτρο αντίθετο προς την τάξη του Θεού. Ο διάβολος τα χρησιμοποιεί όλα αυτά για να επηρεάζει τους ανθρώπους ώστε να αμαρτάνουν ή να σκέφτονται την αμαρτία. Θα σε επηρεάσει με κάποιον τρόπο. Είναι καλή ή κακή η επίδραση της μουσικής που ακούμε; Για παράδειγμα, αν συγκεντρωνόμαστε σε μουσική που επηρεάζει αρνητικά τις σκέψεις ή τον τρόπο ζωής μας, τότε πρόκειται για αρνητική επιρροή που πρέπει να απομακρύνουμε από τη ζωή μας.

Οι Εβραίοι ξεκίνησαν την παράδοση της χρήσης μουσικής χωρίς συνοδεία μετά την πτώση του δεύτερου ναού το 70 μ.Χ., οπότε δεν επιτρέπονταν τα όργανα κατά την περίοδο πένθους μετά την πτώση του. Σε όλη την ιστορία, μέχρι την Αναγέννηση, η οργανική μουσική συνδεόταν κυρίως με τον χορό και τη διασκέδαση. Καθώς δεν μπορούσε κανείς να διασκεδάζει υπερβολικά στους χώρους λατρείας, αυτό το είδος ψυχαγωγικής μουσικής δεν ήταν δημοφιλές στους θρησκευτικούς ηγέτες.

Η φράση a cappella είναι ιταλική και σημαίνει «στο ύφος του παρεκκλησίου». Αρχικά αναφερόταν σε μουσική που τραγουδιόταν σε παρεκκλήσι ή μικρό χώρο λατρείας χωρίς συνοδεία οργάνων, σε αντίθεση με μια μεγάλη εκκλησία όπου ένα εκκλησιαστικό όργανο συνόδευε συνήθως το φωνητικό μέρος. Έκτοτε, ο όρος έφτασε να σημαίνει κάθε μουσική που τραγουδιέται χωρίς συνοδεία, είτε ιερή (θρησκευτική) είτε κοσμική (μη θρησκευτική). Η μουσική a cappella μπορεί να τραγουδιέται από μεγάλη χορωδία, μικρό σύνολο ή σόλο.

Στις ορθόδοξες και συντηρητικές εβραϊκές κοινότητες, εξακολουθεί να υπάρχει η παράδοση να τραγουδούν κυρίως a cappella. Σ’ αυτές τις συναγωγές, συνηθίζεται ο ψάλτης να απαγγέλλει ή να τραγουδά ένα αυθεντικό κείμενο από τις Γραφές, στο οποίο η κοινότητα ανταποκρίνεται με τον ίδιο τρόπο. Τα μόνα όργανα που μπορεί να χρησιμοποιούνται είναι μια διαπασών για να δώσει σε όλους την αρχική νότα ή ένα κέρας κριαριού σε κάποια ειδική περίσταση ή γιορτή.

Η πρώτη εκκλησία ανέπτυξε την παράδοση του a cappella τραγουδιού από την εβραϊκή παράδοση των Εβραίων, ψάλλοντας ψαλμούς ή άλλες Γραφές και χρησιμοποιώντας έναν ψάλτη ως επικεφαλής. Το Γρηγοριανό μέλος ήταν η κυρίαρχη μορφή εκκλησιαστικής μουσικής από περίπου το 590 μ.Χ. Πρόκειται για μία απλή, μελωδική γραμμή, μισομιλημένη και μισοτραγουδισμένη, σε ελεύθερο ρυθμικό ύφος. Στην πρώτη εκκλησία, η οργανική μουσική συνδεόταν με τον αμαρτωλό έξω κόσμο και θεωρούνταν αρνητική επιρροή.

Η παράδοση της ιερής φωνητικής μουσικής χωρίς συνοδεία συνεχίστηκε κατά την Αναγέννηση. Αν και ορισμένες φορές τα όργανα διπλασίαζαν ή αντικαθιστούσαν μια φωνητική γραμμή, η φωνητική μουσική κυρίως στεκόταν από μόνη της. Ο ήχος μιας χορωδίας σε παρεκκλήσι με εξαιρετική ακουστική είχε μια ιδιαίτερα αιθέρια επίδραση.

Ο Τζοβάνι Πιερλουίτζι ντα Παλεστρίνα ήταν ένας από τους σημαντικότερους συνθέτες της Αναγέννησης στην Ιταλία και έγραψε εκατοντάδες λειτουργίες και μοτέτα για την εκκλησία. Το «ύφος Παλεστρίνα», όπως αποκαλείται, ήταν μια σύνθετη μορφή a cappella, όπου πολλές φωνές τραγουδούν διαφορετική μουσική και κείμενο, που εισέρχονται σε διαφορετικές στιγμές. Αυτό ονομαζόταν πολυφωνικό, σε αντίθεση με το ομοφωνικό, που σημαίνει ότι μία μελωδική γραμμή τραγουδιέται από κοινού ή στον ίδιο ρυθμό.

Ο απόστολος Παύλος γράφει: Μιλώντας μεταξύ σας με ψαλμούς και ύμνους και πνευματικά τραγούδια, ψάλλοντας και υμνώντας μέσα στην καρδιά σας τον Κύριο· –Εφεσίους 5:19. Ακούγεται αυτό σαν να φτιάχνουμε μουσική με όργανα; Ή μήπως μοιάζει περισσότερο με το να ψάλλουμε δοξολογίες στον Θεό μέσα από την καρδιά μας;

Και κατά τα μεσάνυχτα ο Παύλος και ο Σίλας προσεύχονταν και έψαλλαν ύμνους στον Θεό, και οι φυλακισμένοι τούς άκουγαν –Πράξεις 16:25. Όταν ο Παύλος και ο Σίλας ήταν στη φυλακή, δεμένοι στα δεσμά και τραγουδούσαν τα μεσάνυχτα, δεν πιστεύω ότι τραγουδούσαν για να δοξάσουν τον εαυτό τους. Τραγουδούσαν για να δοξάσουν τον Θεό Πατέρα. Το αποτέλεσμα του ότι απέδωσαν τη δόξα στον Θεό είναι εντυπωσιακό. Έγινε σεισμός, σείστηκαν τα θεμέλια της φυλακής, άνοιξαν διάπλατα οι πόρτες και λύθηκαν τα δεσμά όλων των φυλακισμένων. Όταν συνέβησαν όλα αυτά, ο δεσμοφύλακας ήρθε τρέμοντας μπροστά στον Παύλο και τον Σίλα και ρώτησε: «Τι πρέπει να κάνω για να σωθώ;»

Η προς Κολοσσαείς επιστολή μάς λέει επίσης ότι πρέπει να Αφήνετε τον λόγο του Χριστού να κατοικεί μέσα σας πλούσια με κάθε σοφία· διδάσκοντας και νουθετώντας ο ένας τον άλλον με ψαλμούς και ύμνους και πνευματικά τραγούδια, ψάλλοντας με χάρη στην καρδιά σας στον Κύριο –Κολοσσαείς 3:16. Αφήνουμε τους ψαλμούς, τους ύμνους και τα πνευματικά τραγούδια να μας διδάσκουν, να μας νουθετούν και να μας ενθαρρύνουν;

Αναρωτιέμαι ποιον ύμνο τραγούδησε ο Ιησούς με τους μαθητές Του στον Μυστικό Δείπνο, πριν βγει προς το Όρος των Ελαιών. Αμφιβάλλω ότι τραγουδούσαν για τον εαυτό τους. Πιστεύω ότι τραγουδούσαν στον ουράνιο Πατέρα τους.

Η αγνή και άγια μουσική είναι ευλογία από τον Κύριο. Είναι κάτι τόσο όμορφα ισχυρό που δεν πρέπει να το θεωρούμε δεδομένο. Μερικές φορές ο Θεός τη χρησιμοποιεί για να μας μιλήσει. Πιστεύω ακράδαντα ότι όλοι οι Χριστιανοί χρειάζεται να ακούν θεάρεστη μουσική όλη την εβδομάδα, όχι μόνο την Κυριακή. Με βοηθά να παραμένω ήρεμος, να παίρνω κουράγιο και να κρατώ τον νου μου στον Κύριο. Όταν ο νους μου είναι στον Κύριο, μπορώ να περάσω ευλογημένα τη μέρα.

Χρειάζεται να πειθαρχούμε τον εαυτό μας στα πράγματα του Θεού. Χρειάζεται επίσης να απαλλαγούμε από πράγματα στη ζωή μας που γνωρίζουμε ότι δεν ευαρεστούν τον Θεό. Η θεάρεστη μουσική (μουσική που στρέφει το πνεύμα και τον νου μας στα πράγματα που προέρχονται από τον Θεό) είναι το είδος μουσικής που πρέπει να ακούν οι πιστοί. Τελικά, όλα ανάγονται στη λατρεία: λατρεύουμε τον Θεό ή κάτι άλλο;

Ο Ιησούς λέει: Αλλά έρχεται ώρα, και είναι τώρα, που οι αληθινοί προσκυνητές θα προσκυνήσουν τον Πατέρα με πνεύμα και αλήθεια· επειδή ο Πατέρας ζητάει τέτοιους να τον προσκυνούν –Ιωάννης 4:23.

Ας ψάλλουμε, λοιπόν, με ειλικρινή λατρεία στον Δημιουργό μας, ας αποδώσουμε στον Θεό τη δόξα για τις φωνές που μας έχει δώσει και ας τραγουδάμε και ας ακούμε αγνά και θεάρεστα τραγούδια για τον Θεό μας.

He was born in a stable, meant for beasts of the field.
It was from the beginning that His will He would yield.

He was never well-liked; despised by all men;
Laughed to scorn, reviled—again, and again.

Yes, His mission on this earth was unusual indeed,
Not seeking money and friends or trying to succeed.

He knew His purpose was to please His Father,
With the trifles of earth, He would not bother.

It surely wasn’t easy, to be the King of kings.
And suffer as a criminal, taking what that brings.

Ten thousand angels, He could have summoned south,
But the stricken Savior opened not His mouth.

With His eyes on the reward, He persevered the pain;
Was cruelly stripped and beaten, and ultimately slain.

But why would He suffer so willingly there;
Enduring the cross, all the pain He did bear?

Because He treasured us, an atonement for our sin
He made when He bled and died there to make us His kin!

I thank God now for that sacrifice so great;
Providing the Lamb and transforming my fate.

I say, “A wonderful Savior, is Jesus my Lord;”
Now the Father and I—a relationship restored!

–Barry Grant

הוא נולד באורווה, שנועדה לבהמות השדה.
כבר מראשית דרכו בחר לעשות את רצונו.

מעולם לא היה אהוד; כל האנשים בזו לו;
לעגו לו וחרפו אותו — שוב ושוב.

אכן, שליחותו בעולם הזה הייתה יוצאת דופן,
הוא לא חיפש כסף וחברים ולא ניסה להצליח.

הוא ידע שתכליתו היא לשמח את אביו,
ובענייני העולם הקטנים לא התעסק.

ודאי לא היה קל להיות מלך המלכים,
ולסבול כפושע, על כל הכרוך בכך.

הוא יכול היה לזמן עשרת אלפים מלאכים מדרום,
אך המושיע המוכה לא פצה את פיו.

עיניו נשואות אל הגמול, הוא עמד בכאב;
הפשיטו אותו באכזריות, הלקו אותו ולבסוף הרגו אותו.

אך מדוע היה מוכן כל כך לסבול שם;
לשאת את הצלב ואת כל הכאב?

כי היינו יקרים לו; כפרה על חטאנו
עשה, כשדימם ומת שם כדי שנהיה בני משפחתו!

אני מודה כעת לאלוהים על הקורבן הגדול הזה;
הוא סיפק את השה ושינה את גורלי.

אני אומר: „מושיע נפלא, ישוע אדוני”;
כעת היחסים ביני לבין האב — שבו והשתקמו!

–בארי גרנט

Greetings in the name of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. We are trusting that each of you as our readers are doing well and continuing to trust the Lord. The pandemic has created a bit of a backlog for us, along with some personal issues we have been working through, so this issue is coming to you somewhat behind schedule. Our apologies…. We plan to get the next issue printed within the next several months to get back on track.

In the last issue’s editorial, I wrote about an obscure news article which revealed that many folks across the world were surprised by the positive outcomes they were experiencing through the need to stay at home during the beginning of the Covid-19 pandemic. They were enjoying family time. They were finding camaraderie in facing this challenge together. They were finding excitement in the adventure of discovering new ways to function and survive. And they were finding renewed vision and purpose in life.

However, as time has passed, this seems to have been short-lived by all who did not have a deeper level of stability in their lives. After a varying amount of time has elapsed for many folks, reality has begun to set in. Some have lost their jobs. Some have lost loved ones. Some have gone through a time of sickness. Many have been starved for fellowship with other human beings. For the elderly living in nursing homes and assisted-living facilities, and those requiring hospitalization, life has become a very lonely existence indeed, since most of these places have not allowed visitors to enter their doors.

The world is trying to find any way possible to cope and survive. There are phone conference lines. There are chat lines. There are webinars geared towards the issue. Many are doing their part to fill the gaps that this pandemic has created in the lives of the people around them.

As we step back to gain a clearer perspective of the unfolding events brought about by the pandemic, the last number of months have been a time of change and uncertainty for most. There’s the economic future, “Is my job secure?” “What about my bills?” “What about my housing?” Then there’s the greatly politicized nature of numerous issues—race inequality, conspiracy theories about the pandemic, and the government mandates regarding our response to the virus pandemic. Add to this the polarization in our country regarding politics—who is telling the truth on issues, and who will be the best option to lead the country after the upcoming election.

Despite everything else that is going on, the virus and its effects seem to be on everyone’s mind. On August 15, 2020 there was an article published by CNN, written by Ryan Prior, titled: “1 IN 4 YOUNG PEOPLE ARE REPORTING SUICIDAL THOUGHTS”. For those wanting to read the article, it can be found here:

https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/14/health/young-people-suicidal-ideation-wellness/index.html

This article recognizes that there were positive effects during the onset of the pandemic and the resulting stay-at-home orders. This article goes on to say that as time has passed this event is different than most past events, such as tornadoes, hurricanes, earthquakes, and even the circumstances of 9/11. Most of these events have been localized and brief in their destructive effects, while the Covid-19 pandemic has dragged on for so long that it is becoming a way of life—with no end in sight, and its beginning is fading into our forgetful past.

According to the news article, the CDC has published data from a survey which was conducted to determine the outcome of the negative effects of the pandemic. Following are some facts as presented in the article:

  • Suicidal ideation is up among young people since last year
  • As many as one in four people ages 18 through 24 having seriously considered suicide in the 30 days preceding the survey (researchers surveyed 5,412 adults in the US between June 24 and 30.)
  • In the general US population … 11% of adults surveyed had seriously considered suicide in the past 30 days before they completed the survey.
  • The number of Americans reporting anxiety symptoms is three times the number at this same time last year, the CDC said.
  • The results reflect a nation increasingly on edge.

How sad it is to ponder this reality. As I read this news article, I had to wonder whether the percentages are the same for the church as they are for the world. A verse of scripture came to mind: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable –1 Corinthians 15:19. As Christians…

  • …we have HOPE!
  • …we have HOPE IN CHRIST!!
  • …we have HOPE both IN THIS LIFE and FOR ETERNITY!!!

Considering all this we should have a smile on our faces, hope in our hearts, and an encouraging word on our lips for all with whom we come in contact. Let’s be especially observant as we interact with the people around us—family, friend, and even the stranger. Who knows, maybe the neighbor next door is feeling all alone and discouraged. Or perhaps our best friend from church has been struggling with a burden that seems more than they can bear. As we pray, we can ask God to bring people to our minds that would be blessed by our assistance of one sort or another. We never know when our smile or encouraging word will help make a change in someone’s eternal welfare.

Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted. Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ. For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself. But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another. For every man shall bear his own burden –Galatians 6:1-5.

There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able… –1 Corinthians 10:13.

My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience –James 1:2-3.

In these verses, I see a number of things that God wants us to use to live by.

  1. God will not allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to endure. This is according to His fact, not according to our feeling.
  2. Each of us WILL fall into temptations, but as we see God’s sovereignty involved in our trials, we can rest as we “count it all joy”.
  3. When it seems that our faith is being tried and tested, sometimes seemingly almost to the breaking point, we can rest assured that God is in the middle of it and that He is up to something according to His will.
  4. God will allow burdens into each of our lives and He expects each of us to “bear our own burdens”.
  5. God will allow our fellow man to go through times of difficulty, during which God expects us to see our struggling brother or sister and do whatever we can to help ease the burden—through prayer, words of encouragement, or deeds of assistance.

In closing, I will leave you with several verses that Paul wrote to the church of Galatia. And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not. As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith. –Galatians 6:9-10. As strangers and pilgrims here on this earth, let’s not lose sight of our Eternal Home, our Sympathetic Savior, our Sovereign God, and our Abba Father.

Hälsningar i vår Herres och Frälsares, Jesu Kristi, namn. Vi hoppas att ni alla som läser vår tidskrift mår bra och fortsätter att förtrösta på Herren. Pandemin har gjort att vi har hamnat lite efter i arbetet, tillsammans med en del personliga omständigheter som vi har försökt hantera, så det här numret kommer till er något senare än planerat. Vi ber om ursäkt … Vi planerar att få nästa nummer tryckt inom de närmaste månaderna för att komma i fas igen.

I ledaren i förra numret skrev jag om en föga uppmärksammad nyhetsartikel som visade att många människor världen över blev förvånade över de positiva följder de upplevde av att behöva stanna hemma i början av covid-19-pandemin. De fick njuta av tid med familjen. De fann gemenskap i att möta den här utmaningen tillsammans. De kände spänning inför äventyret att upptäcka nya sätt att fungera och överleva. Och de fick en förnyad vision och mening med livet.

Men med tiden verkar detta ha blivit kortvarigt för alla som inte hade en djupare stabilitet i sina liv. När olika lång tid har gått för många människor har verkligheten börjat sjunka in. En del har förlorat sina arbeten. En del har förlorat närstående. En del har varit sjuka. Många har saknat gemenskap med andra människor. För äldre som bor på vårdhem och boenden med omsorg, och för dem som behöver sjukhusvård, har livet verkligen blivit en mycket ensam tillvaro, eftersom de flesta av dessa platser inte har tillåtit besökare att komma in.

Världen försöker hitta alla tänkbara sätt att hantera situationen och överleva. Det finns telefonkonferenser. Det finns chattlinjer. Det finns webbseminarier inriktade på frågan. Många gör sin del för att fylla de tomrum som pandemin har skapat i människors liv omkring dem.

När vi tar ett steg tillbaka för att få ett tydligare perspektiv på de händelser som pandemin har fört med sig, har de senaste månaderna varit en tid av förändring och osäkerhet för de flesta. Där finns den ekonomiska framtiden: ”Är mitt arbete tryggat?” ”Hur blir det med mina räkningar?” ”Hur blir det med mitt boende?” Sedan finns den starkt politiserade karaktären hos många frågor – rasojämlikhet, konspirationsteorier om pandemin och regeringens påbud om hur vi ska reagera på viruspandemin. Därtill kommer polariseringen i vårt land kring politiken – vem som talar sanning i olika frågor och vem som är det bästa valet att leda landet efter det kommande valet.

Trots allt annat som pågår verkar viruset och dess följder vara i allas tankar. Den 15 augusti 2020 publicerade CNN en artikel skriven av Ryan Prior med rubriken: ”1 AV 4 UNGA MÄNNISKOR UPPGER ATT DE HAR SJÄLVMORDSTANKAR”. För den som vill läsa artikeln finns den här:

https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/14/health/young-people-suicidal-ideation-wellness/index.html

Artikeln konstaterar att det fanns positiva följder när pandemin började och de efterföljande besluten om att stanna hemma trädde i kraft. Artikeln fortsätter med att säga att denna händelse skiljer sig från de flesta tidigare händelser, såsom tornador, orkaner, jordbävningar och till och med omständigheterna kring 11 september. De flesta av dessa händelser har varit lokala och kortvariga i sina destruktiva följder, medan covid-19-pandemin har dragit ut på tiden så länge att den håller på att bli ett sätt att leva – utan något slut i sikte, och dess början bleknar bort i vårt glömska förflutna.

Enligt nyhetsartikeln har CDC publicerat uppgifter från en undersökning som genomfördes för att fastställa följderna av pandemins negativa effekter. Här följer några fakta som återges i artikeln:

  • Självmordstankar har blivit vanligare bland unga sedan förra året
  • Så många som en av fyra personer i åldern 18 till 24 år hade allvarligt övervägt självmord under de 30 dagar som föregick undersökningen (forskarna undersökte 5 412 vuxna i USA mellan den 24 och 30 juni.)
  • I den allmänna befolkningen i USA … hade 11 % av de vuxna som deltog i undersökningen allvarligt övervägt självmord under de 30 dagar som föregick deras svar på undersökningen.
  • Antalet amerikaner som uppger symtom på ångest är tre gånger så stort som vid samma tid förra året, uppgav CDC.
  • Resultaten speglar en nation som blir alltmer orolig.

Så sorgligt det är att begrunda denna verklighet. När jag läste den här nyhetsartikeln kunde jag inte låta bli att undra om andelarna är desamma i kyrkan som i världen. En bibelvers kom för mig: Om vi i detta livet endast har ett hopp i Kristus, då är vi de mest beklagansvärda av alla människor –1 Korinthierbrevet 15:19. Som kristna …

  • … har vi HOPP!
  • … har vi HOPP I KRISTUS!!
  • … har vi HOPP både I DETTA LIV och FÖR EVIGHETEN!!!

När vi tänker på allt detta borde vi ha ett leende på läpparna, hopp i hjärtat och ett uppmuntrande ord på tungan för alla vi möter. Låt oss vara särskilt uppmärksamma när vi umgås med människorna omkring oss – familj, vänner och till och med främlingar. Vem vet, kanske känner grannen bredvid sig helt ensam och modlös. Eller kanske har vår bästa vän i kyrkan kämpat med en börda som verkar mer än han eller hon orkar bära. När vi ber kan vi be Gud föra människor till våra tankar som skulle bli välsignade av att vi hjälper dem på något sätt. Vi vet aldrig när vårt leende eller uppmuntrande ord kan bidra till att förändra någons eviga väl.

Bröder, om någon ertappas med en överträdelse, ska ni som är andliga upprätta en sådan i en mild ande. Men se till dig själv, så att inte också du blir frestad. Bär varandras bördor, så uppfyller ni Kristi lag. Om någon tror sig vara något, fast han ingenting är, bedrar han sig själv. Men var och en ska pröva sin egen gärning. Då kan han ha sin berömmelse för sig själv och inte för någon annan. Var och en ska nämligen bära sin egen börda –Galaterbrevet 6:1-5.

Ingen annan frestelse har drabbat er än sådana som människor möter. Gud är trofast och ska inte låta er bli frestade utöver er förmåga … –1 Korinthierbrevet 10:13.

Mina bröder, räkna det som den största glädje när ni råkar ut för olika slags prövningar. Ni vet ju att när er tro prövas, leder det till uthållighet –Jakobsbrevet 1:2-3.

I dessa verser ser jag flera saker som Gud vill att vi ska leva efter.

  1. Gud kommer inte att låta oss frestas mer än vi förmår uthärda. Detta grundar sig på hans faktum, inte på vår känsla.
  2. Var och en av oss KOMMER att råka ut för frestelser, men när vi ser Guds suveränitet verksam i våra prövningar kan vi finna ro när vi ”räknar det som den största glädje”.
  3. När det verkar som om vår tro prövas och sätts på prov, ibland till synes nästan till bristningsgränsen, kan vi vara förvissade om att Gud är mitt i det och att han gör något i enlighet med sin vilja.
  4. Gud kommer att låta bördor komma in i var och ens liv, och han förväntar sig att var och en av oss ska ”bära sin egen börda”.
  5. Gud kommer att låta våra medmänniskor gå igenom svåra tider, då han förväntar sig att vi ska se vår kämpande bror eller syster och göra vad vi kan för att lätta bördan – genom bön, uppmuntrande ord eller hjälpande handlingar.

Avslutningsvis lämnar jag er med några verser som Paulus skrev till församlingen i Galatien. Låt oss inte tröttna på att göra gott. När tiden är inne får vi skörda, om vi inte ger upp. Låt oss därför, medan vi har tillfälle, göra gott mot alla människor, särskilt mot dem som delar vår tro. –Galaterbrevet 6:9-10. Som främlingar och pilgrimer här på jorden, låt oss inte tappa vårt eviga hem, vår medkännande Frälsare, vår suveräne Gud och vår Abba Fader ur sikte.

Many people ask, “Is listening to secular music a sin? Is there anything wrong with CCM (Christian Contemporary Music)? Is it okay for Christians to listen to rap, rock, country, pop, or rhythm and blues?” For the sake of this article, I am going to refer to all the music listed above as “secular” music.

Should Christians only listen to “A cappella” music? Music is compelling, and it can have a significant effect on how we live our lives. Music influences us negatively or positively. We should ask the question, “Does the music that I listen to draw me closer to God, or does it push me away from Him and closer to Satan?”

The primary purpose of music is to worship (the expression of reverence and adoration to something or someone). Yet at times we as believers still fail in listening to good wholesome music. This is a problem since most secular music is evil and promotes things that God hates.

Secular music is very catchy and addicting. The flesh would rather listen to secular music than to godly music. This type of music negatively influences the mind and is not profitable. If the song encourages evil, promotes worldliness, gives you bad thoughts, changes your actions for the wrong, and influences your speech for the wrong, we should not be listening to it. When it comes to music, we can comfortably lie to ourselves in this area. Have you lied to yourself? Have you said, “God is OK with this type of music,” yet deep down in your heart, you know He is convicting you, and that He is NOT OK with it?

Secular music is often sensual. The meaning of sensual is “of arousing gratification of the senses and physical.” Is the music that we listen to sensual? Does it put our mind in a state of just going with the beat? How do our bodies want to respond when we listen to such music? If our bodies swing with the rhythm of the music, it is not honoring to the Lord; it is not bringing glory to His name; it is not putting our mind and body in a position to worship the Lord.

We always worship something when we listen to music. If we are concentrating on music that is not of God, we are worshiping our flesh, the world, or even the devil. Usually, music like CCM tends to draw attention to ourselves and not to God. Music like this is very sensual. Can we truly worship God when we listen to this type of music?

CCM is a genre of modern popular music in which the lyrics are focused on matters concerned with the Christian faith. It formed as those affected by the 1960s’ “Jesus movement” revival began to express themselves with a more contemporary style of music. Before that, it was hymns and other gospel songs that were prevalent in the church at the time. Whether we know it or not, much of the CCM adds a pulsating beat (syncopation) at a place that it is not naturally supposed to be. The pulsating beat that is relevant in CCM does not appeal to the spirit of man in worship, rather, it appeals to the flesh. The type of music that appeals to the flesh is not of God but is of the devil. Today, CCM is a term that is used to refer to pop, rock, or praise & worship styles of rhythm and beat, so long as the lyrics fall under the definition of CCM.

Philippians tells us that we are supposed to think on … whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things –Philippians 4:8.

Secular music does not pass the Philippians 4:8 test. Most secular music has lyrics that are impure, while all of it has a rhythm or beat that is against God’s order. The devil uses it all to influence people to sin or to think about sin. It will affect you in some way. Is the influence of the music that we listen to good or bad? For example, if we are concentrating on music that affects our thoughts or lifestyle in the wrong way, then it is a negative influence that we must put out of our lives.

The Hebrews started the tradition of using music without accompaniment after the fall of the second temple in 70 A.D., at which time instruments were not allowed during a period of mourning after the fall. Throughout history up until The Renaissance, instrumental music was mostly associated with dancing and merry making. As one could not have too much fun in places of worship, this kind of amusing music was not popular with religious leaders.

A cappella is an Italian phrase which means “in the style of the chapel”. It was initially used to refer to music that was sung in a chapel or small worship space without accompanying instruments, as opposed to a large church where an organ usually attended vocal music. The term has since come to mean any music sung without accompaniment, whether sacred (religious) or secular (non-religious). A cappella music can be sung by a large choir, a small group, or as a solo.

In Orthodox and Conservative Jewish congregations, the tradition of singing mostly A cappella still exists. In these synagogues, it is customary for a cantor to chant or sing an authoritative text from the scriptures which the congregation responds to in kind. The only instruments used might be a pitch pipe to give everyone a starting note or a ram’s horn on a special occasion or a holiday.

The early church developed the tradition of A cappella singing from the Hebrews’ Jewish tradition, chanting psalms, or other scriptures and using a cantor as a leader. Gregorian chant was the dominant form of church music starting around 590 A.D. It is a single, simple, melodic line half-spoken, half-sung in a free rhythmic style. In the early church, instrumental music was associated with the sinful outside world and was considered a negative influence.

The tradition of unaccompanied sacred vocal music continued during The Renaissance. Although instruments sometimes doubled or substituted for a vocal line, vocal music mostly stood on its own. The sound of a choir of voices in a chapel with excellent acoustics had a particularly ethereal effect.

Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina was one of the most significant composers of The Renaissance in Italy, writing hundreds of masses and motets for the church. ‘The Palestrina Style,’ as it is called, was a sophisticated A cappella form using many voices singing with different music and text coming in at different times. This was called polyphonic, as opposed to homophonic, which means one melodic line sung together or in the same rhythm.

The Apostle Paul writes, Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; –Ephesians 5:19. Does that sound like making music with instruments? Or does it rather seem like singing praises to God from the heart?

And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them –Acts 16:25. When Paul and Silas were in prison, and they were in stocks singing at midnight, I don’t believe that they were singing to bring glory to themselves. They were singing to bring glory to God the Father. The result of them giving God the glory is quite astounding. There was an earthquake, the foundations of the prison shook, the doors flew open, and everyone’s prison bands broke. At the end of this happening, the jailor came trembling before Paul and Silas and asked: “What must I do to be saved?”

Colossians also tells us that we should Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord –Colossians 3:16. Do we let psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs teach us, admonish us, and encourage us?

I wonder what hymn Jesus sang with His disciples at the last supper before He went out to the Mount of Olives. I doubt that they were singing to themselves. I believe they were singing to their heavenly Father.

Pure and holy music is a blessing from the Lord. It is such a beautifully powerful thing that we should not take for granted. Sometimes God uses it to speak to us. I firmly believe that all Christians need to be listening to godly music throughout the week, not just on Sunday. It helps me stay calm, be encouraged, and keep my mind on the Lord. When my mind is on the Lord, I can go through the day blest.

We need to discipline ourselves with the things of God. We also need to get rid of things in our life that we know God is not pleased with. Godly music (music that draws our spirit and mind to the things that are from God) is the type of music that believers should listen to. Worship is what it boils down to, do we worship God or something else?

Jesus says, But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him –John 4:23.

So, let us sing in sincere worship to our Creator, let us give God the glory for the voices that He has given us, and let us sing and listen to godly, wholesome songs to our God.
